The '''1999–2000 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 64th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 19 September 1999 and ended on 28 May 2000. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their fourth consecutive and 29th Greek title.
